correctness.rationale: The statement is about all positive side lengths, including the one-chain degenerations, in the pure reflexive product order. In a chain with r rounds remaining, preserve equality of corresponding gap sizes or keep both at least 2^r−1; after a fresh move use threshold 2^(r−1)−1 for both subgaps. The coordinate strategies preserve equalities, repeats and coordinatewise comparisons in the product. It follows that every rectangle has the type of its sorted coordinatewise seven-cap. The triple's full atomic diagram includes all relations among the assigned coordinates. Its projections recover the atomic diagrams of shorter prefixes because these structures are nonempty. Recursively taking the sets of full extension types, not their multiplicities, gives exactly the three-move game profiles. A separate exact computation of all 28 capped pairs reproduced the entire 21-class partition, all least representatives, seven distinct chain types, and the class-21 grouping. Since capping cannot increase area, the smallest area among the class-21 canonical grids, 30 at 5×6, is also the within-family minimum. No class needs a bigger representative.
residual_risks: The independent computation exhausts the canonical domain only. The general conclusion uses the symbolic gap and product arguments; no more expressive language or outside-family minimum is claimed.

evidence: Products of two nonempty finite chains are pure-order isomorphic to divisor lattices on at most two prime factors, with a singleton coordinate for an absent prime. Strict and reflexive versions of the same product order are interdefinable without quantifiers. The 6735f2bcf75a finding uses the same product order and includes singleton factors.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Neither prime-exponent relabeling nor taking order duals gives a new quotient. King-grid or path-grid adjacency on the same vertices is a different relation. Requiring both coordinates to be strictly less is also different: a 1×b rectangle in that relation is an antichain, not the chain in this finding.
